rachel (docs): FYI: we're publishing a docs + SDK announcement to deprecate the synchronous embeddings endpoint in favor of the new async Jobs embeddings API. This affects heavy-batch embedding workflows. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1731

samir (sdk): Short impact: SDK helpers that call `client.embeddings.sync(...)` should move to `client.jobs.create({ type: 'embeddings', ... })` and poll/watch results. We'll ship helper wrappers in SDK to ease migration.

hong (ml-eng): Reason: large-batch sync calls were causing tail-latency spikes and coupling runtime memory to request size. Jobs lets us stage, retry, and shard without blocking callers. Runtime will continue to accept sync for 90 days as a shim and emit `Deprecation-Warning` headers.

zoe (product): Timeline request: when can marketing/Docs share the change? We need dates to plan customer comms and webinar mention.

rachel (docs): Proposed timeline: preview deploy tomorrow, canary flip in 3 days, full flip in 7 days. Deprecation window: 90 days after flip. We'll add banners, changelog, and a migration recipe.

mike (support): I'll prepare KB with step-by-step migration, sample polling code, and canned replies for customers hitting 429/500s. Also compiling list of top customers doing bulk embeddings.

samir (sdk): Example migration snippet for quick copy/paste: 
```js
// OLD (sync)
const res = await client.embeddings.sync({ model: 'embed-2', input: bigArray })
// NEW (jobs)
const job = await client.jobs.create({ type: 'embeddings', model: 'embed-2', input: bigArray })
const out = await client.jobs.wait(job.id)
```

samir (sdk): We'll provide `client.embeddings.fromJob(jobId)` helper and a `compat` flag so teams can opt into shim behavior during migration. We'll also publish patch SDKs with warnings when `embeddings.sync` is used.

hong (ml-eng): Runtime plan: accept sync requests but return 202 + Location header pointing to job for requests over threshold, so clients are nudged to Jobs. We'll log metrics and set a hard reject after 90 days for oversized sync requests.
